description:
Pensions is the easiest way to quickly estimate your income at retirement.

Change values like how much you contribute or your retirement age and see the results update.

Make changes and discuss it with ChatGPT.

e.g.

- "Help me calculate my pension"
- "I'm 45 with 200K in my pension. How much do I need to contribute so I can retire at 60 on 50K/year?"
- "Is 300/month enough to retire at 55?"

defaultPrompt: If I start saving now, what can I retire on?
